name: StarGait
summary:
Transform your surroundings into an interactive space adventure with StarGait, an augmented reality experience that encourages walking, balance, coordination, and full-body movement.

Using passthrough augmented reality, StarGait overlays pathways, targets, and interactive challenges into your real environment, allowing you to move naturally while staying aware of your surroundings.
